[[File:Venom_assault_trooper.jpg|thumb|right|A Venom assault trooper]]
'''Venom assault troopers''' were elite [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] that served with the [[Core Fleet|Galactic Alliance Core Fleet]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. They were specialists in [[Starship/Legends|ship]] to ship boarding actions.<ref name="LECG">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

Deployed from [[Sabertooth-class assault/rescue vessel|''Sabertooth''-class assault/rescue vessels]], [[Venom assault squad]]s breached enemy vessels when their [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]] used the "teeth" on the bow of the craft to latch onto opposing ships. [[Trooper/Legends|Troopers]] would then pour into the captured ship from multiple breach points, subduing enemy resistance and securing objectives. Most Venom assault squads were permanently assigned to a single ''Sabertooth''-class vessel.<ref name="LECG" />

==Armor and equipment==
Standard equipment included [[Venom Assault armor]], which was vacuum-sealed powered [[Armor/Legends|armor]] with limited jump jet capability for maneuverability in zero gravity environments. Their weapons included [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbines]] and [[Vibrosword/Legends|vibroswords]], as well as [[Stun/Legends|stun]], [[Concussion/Legends|concussion]] and [[Gas grenade/Legends|gas grenades]]. In addition, they used floating [[Surveillance droid/Legends|surveillance droids]] to [[Scout/Legends|scout]] out enemy positions or as programmable weapons platforms.<ref name="LECG" />

Known units that operated in the Core Fleet included [[Venom Zero]] and [[Redclaw Venom One]].<ref name="LECG" />
